name: fade-in
concept: Opacity climbs from nothing to fully visible, with no movement. The plainest way to say an element has arrived.

name: slide-in-up
concept: The element rises up into place from just below its resting position while fading in. Reads as content arriving from off-screen, like a toast or a bottom sheet.

name: slide-in-down
concept: The element drops down into place from just above its resting position while fading in. Reads as a banner or a dropdown arriving from the top of the screen.

name: slide-in-left
concept: The element travels in from the left edge to its resting position while fading in. Reads as a panel or drawer opening from the left side.
keywords: come in from the left side

name: slide-in-right
concept: The element travels in from the right edge to its resting position while fading in. Reads as a panel or drawer opening from the right side.

name: scale-in
concept: The element grows from slightly smaller than its resting size up to full size while fading in. A calmer, centered entrance than a slide, good for cards and dialogs.

name: pop-in
concept: The element springs in from small, overshoots slightly past full size, then settles. A playful, energetic entrance for something new and welcome.
